source: 外研社(新标准)必修三 Unit 4 同主题完形(参观美术馆/学书法/瓷器制作/街头艺术家/学校美术社/雕塑家的一天)。用词限 U4/初中/常见词,答案唯一,选项同词性,与阅读/听力关不撞文章。

passages.title: A Visit to the Art Museum
passages.text: Last Saturday my class (1)____ a famous art museum in the city. As soon as we (2)____ inside, a friendly guide came to (3)____ us at the door. She told us that thousands of (4)____ are kept in the building, which was once a royal palace. We walked up the wide stone (5)____ to the first floor, where the most famous works hang. My favourite was a (6)____ of an old king, painted hundreds of years ago. The guide explained that the picture was being (7)____ by experts to keep its colours bright. In another room, we saw beautiful blue-and-white (8)____ cups decorated with dragons. Before we left, I bought a small (9)____ of my favourite painting to put on my wall. It was a wonderful day, and I now understand why so many people are (10)____ of visiting museums.

passages.title: Learning Calligraphy from Grandfather
passages.text: When I was ten, my grandfather began to (1)____ me Chinese calligraphy. At first, holding the brush felt strange, and my hand would not (2)____ the way I wanted. passages.title: How Porcelain Is Made
passages.text: Have you ever wondered how a beautiful blue-and-white (1)____ bowl is made? The work begins with soft clay, which is shaped on a fast-spinning wheel. The maker must be (2)____ and careful, because one small mistake can ruin the whole piece. After the bowl has dried, an artist (3)____ a design onto it with a thin brush. Many bowls are decorated with dragons, flowers or (4)____ of mountains and rivers. The colours are mostly different (5)____ of blue. Next, the bowl is put into a very hot oven, where it is (6)____ for many hours. The great heat makes the clay hard and gives the surface a smooth (7)____. When the bowl comes out, the blue design shines (8)____ against the white. A single fine bowl can take many days to (9)____, so we should treat such works with (10)____. Each one is truly a small masterpiece.

passages.title: The Young Street Artist
passages.text: Leo is sixteen, and he is already a well-known artist in our (1)____. He does not paint inside a museum or a (2)____. Instead, he creates huge, colourful pictures on old walls and bridges. Some neighbours think his (3)____ is messy, but most young people love it. Then he plans his picture (6)____ on paper. On painting day, his friends often come to (7)____ him work. Bit by bit, the dull wall is (8)____ into something bright and alive. Leo hopes that one day his art will (9)____ other young people to be creative. "Art should not be locked away," he says. "It should be (10)____ for everyone to enjoy."

passages.title: Our School Art Club
passages.text: Every Friday afternoon, the art club in our school (1)____ in Room 12. About twenty students join, and our teacher, Mr Lin, makes each lesson great (2)____. My best friend Mia is very (6)____ at drawing animals, while I prefer to paint flowers in a (7)____. At the end of each term, our work is (8)____ on the walls of the school hall for everyone to see. passages.title: A Day with a Sculptor
passages.text: Last summer, I spent a day watching a (1)____ at work in his studio. His name is Mr Carter, and he makes statues out of stone and metal. Tiny bits of (6)____ covered the floor around him. He told me that one big statue can take several (7)____ to finish. He is very (8)____, and he never rushes his work.
